Hello!

Do we have a ship date and tracking number for batch 1 yet?

Thanks,
Jon
Note to the team: I'll look into this. Let me check what I have.

Hi Jon,

Happy to check that for you. I don't have your order number in front of me in this thread, so send it over (it's the Shop number on your confirmation, like Shop····) and I'll pull your line up and give you the ship date for your batch.

One thing I can tell you now: a tracking number only exists once the unit leaves our warehouse, so while a batch is still inbound to us there's nothing to track yet. You can follow that incoming shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Reply with the order number and I'll come straight back with your date.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

My order number is Shop····.

Thanks,

Jon

Hi Jon,

Thanks, I've got it. Order Shop····, one Harlo B30 plus the free Power Kit, going to (address hidden).

No tracking number yet, and here's why. Your B30 is in batch 1, the batch we wrote to you about on September 15 when the cooling was redesigned. Batch 1 has now finished production and left China, and it's on its way to our warehouse. Your unit ships out to you once that batch is checked in, and the tracking number is emailed to you automatically the moment it leaves.

You can follow that incoming shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sorry it has taken longer than the mid October window we gave you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
